rows.source: Random assignment and random sampling serve different purposes. Random assignment can reduce confounding within the experiment; it does not automatically make the sample representative of the population.
rows.previousTarget: Tugas acak dan acak pengambilan sampel melayani tujuan yang berbeda. Tugas acak dapat mengurangi konfounding dalam percobaan; ini tidak secara otomatis membuat perwakilan sampel dari populasi.

rows.note: Random assignment and confounding are repaired. Perwakilan sampel dari populasi still leaves the representativeness relation unclear; keep open.

rows.source: A binding price ceiling can create excess demand. This statement concerns the quantity buyers wish to purchase relative to the quantity sellers offer, not a change in people's preferences.
